changes.text: When your oshi has a bad week, the shares of them you held all week pay no share fee at Saturday's review. A good week still pays a dividend on every share. Shares bought during the week are covered from the next one.
Your oshi's stock page shows how many of your shares are covered this week, and the Dividend Review shows the fee your oshi skipped.
Your oshi can now change once every 30 days. Your first pick is free, and removing your oshi is always allowed. Protection starts after a full week with your new oshi.
